Ochako wasn't a big baseball fan, but foreigners came to the match against the local league today, and a sense of patriotism took over. All the seats, and even more so the seats, were sold out in advance, so I had to stand behind the stands, holding on to the railing — even if she were not allowed into the stadium, she would continue to shout slogans in support of her team and wave a scarf with its emblem and would not erase the Japanese flag painted on her cheek.*
